The best classics on PS Plus Premium

PS Plus Premium comes with a back catalogue of PS1, PS2 and PSP games, plus a handful of PS4 remasters, that you can download and play on PS4 or PS5. Plenty of them have aged, but the best still play brilliantly, and a few are hard to find anywhere else. These are our ten favourites, and each one says what it's like to play today. The full list of classics follows.

What counts as a classic

Sony calls these Premium Classics: games first released on the PS1, PS2 or PSP, emulated so they run on PS4 and PS5, along with a few PS4 remasters of older games. Most get small upgrades like rewind and save states, and some PS1 games come in more than one regional version, so check you've picked the right one.

This list counts every Premium Classic available in Canada and the US. It leaves out the PS3 games Premium streams from the cloud, which work differently and aren't offered in every country.

1

Tekken 3

PS1 fighting game, 1998 · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 96 · about 2 h main story

The fighting game many people still rank as the series' best, with a big, varied cast, fast and readable fights, and the daft Tekken Force and Tekken Ball modes on the side. It's perfect for a quick round with a friend on the couch.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

2

Resident Evil 3: Nemesis

PS1 survival horror, 1999 · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 91 · about 6.8 h main story

Jill Valentine tries to escape Raccoon City while Nemesis, a relentless monster with a rocket launcher, hunts her through the streets. Fixed camera angles and tank controls take a little getting used to, but the tension holds up.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

3

Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy

PS2 platformer, 2001 · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 90 · about 9.9 h main story

A bright, open platformer from the studio that went on to make Uncharted, with a whole island to explore without loading screens and a wisecracking sidekick turned into a weasel. It's an easy, cheerful game to play through in a few evenings.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

4

Ape Escape

PS1 platformer, 1999 · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 90 · about 7.1 h main story

You catch escaped monkeys with a net, using the right stick for your gadgets in one of the first games built around the DualShock. It's inventive, funny and still feels fresh.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

5

Syphon Filter

PS1 stealth action, 1999 · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 90 · about 10 h main story

Gabe Logan chases a bioterrorist through a mix of stealth and third-person shooting, complete with the series' famous taser. It's rough around the edges now, but the spy-thriller pace still carries it.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

6

TimeSplitters 2

PS2 shooter, 2002 · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 90 · about 7.1 h main story

A time-travelling shooter from former GoldenEye developers, best known for its huge, silly split-screen multiplayer and its fast, tightly made story levels. It's one of the best couch multiplayer games in the catalogue.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

7

Grandia

PS1 JRPG, 1999 · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 89 · about 42 h main story

A warm, sprawling adventure about a boy who wants to explore the world, with one of the best turn-based battle systems of its era. It takes its time, but it's a lovely, optimistic game to sink into.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

8

Sly 2: Band of Thieves

PS2 stealth platformer, 2004 · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 88 · about 15 h main story

Sly Cooper and his gang plan elaborate heists across Europe, swapping between a thief, a tech whizz and a strongman. Its cel-shaded look has aged better than most PS2 games.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

9

Oddworld: Abe's Exoddus

PS1 puzzle platformer, 1998 · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 88 · about 15 h main story

Abe has to lead his fellow Mudokons to safety through puzzle-filled factories, using chants, possession and a lot of trial and error. It's dark, strange and very funny, and it's tough.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

10

Dark Cloud 2

PS2 JRPG, 2002 · PS4 · Metascore 87 · about 50 h main story

A cheerful action RPG where you fight through dungeons, invent weapons, take photos and rebuild towns, all at once. It's huge and gloriously unfocused, and easy to lose a month to.

Questions

What's the best classic on PS Plus Premium?

By Metascore it's Tekken 3. For a long single-player game, Grandia or Dark Cloud 2.

Can I play PS Plus classics on PS5?

Yes. Every game on this list runs on PS4 and PS5, and most have extras like rewind and save states.

Are the original Resident Evil games on PS Plus?

Yes, all three PS1 games are in Premium: Resident Evil Director's Cut, Resident Evil 2 and Resident Evil 3: Nemesis.

Are there classic JRPGs on PS Plus?

Plenty. Grandia, Dark Cloud 2 and Jeanne d'Arc are the highest rated, and our JRPG list has more.

Do classics need PS Plus Premium?

Yes. These come only with Premium, or Deluxe in countries without Premium. Extra doesn't include them.

Are PS3 games included?

Premium can stream a separate set of PS3 games in some countries, including Canada and the US. They aren't on this list.
